sn10.8:1.1: On one occasion the Blessed One was dwelling at Rajagaha in the Cool Grove
sn10.8:1.2: Now on that occasion the householder Anathapindika had arrived in Rajagaha on some business
sn10.8:1.4: “A Buddha, it is said, has arisen in the world!”
sn10.8:1.5: He wanted to go and see the Blessed One immediately, but it occurred to him:
sn10.8:1.6: “It is not the right time to go and see the Blessed One today
sn10.8:1.7: I will go and see the Blessed One early tomorrow morning”
sn10.8:1.8: During the night he got up three times thinking it was morning.
sn10.8:1.9: Then the householder Anathapindika approached the gate of the charnel ground
sn10.8:1.11: Then, as the householder Anathapindika was leaving the city, the light disappeared and darkness appeared. Fear, trepidation, and terror arose in him and he wanted to turn back
sn10.8:1.12: But the yakkha Sivaka, invisible, made the proclamation:
sn10.8:2.5: Are not worth a sixteenth part
sn10.8:3.3: Going forward is better for you
sn10.8:4.1: ‘Then the darkness disappeared and light appeared to the householder Anathapindika, and the fear, trepidation, and terror that had arisen in him subsided.

sn10.8:10.1: ‘Then the darkness disappeared and light appeared to the householder Anathapindika, and the fear, trepidation, and terror that had arisen in him subsided.
sn10.8:10.2: Then the householder Anathapindika approached the Blessed One in the Cool Grove.
sn10.8:11.1: Now on that occasion the Blessed One, having risen at the first blush of dawn, was walking back and forth in the open.
sn10.8:11.2: The Blessed One saw the householder Anathapindika coming in the distance.
sn10.8:11.3: He descended from the walkway, sat down in the seat that was prepared
sn10.8:11.4: and said to the householder Anathapindika:
sn10.8:11.6: Then the householder Anathapindika, thinking, “The Blessed One has addressed me by my name,” [thrilled and elated], prostrated himself right on the spot with his head at the Blessed One's feet
sn10.8:11.7: “I hope, venerable sir, that the Blessed One slept well.”
